title.zh: 知识库答不准，问题通常不在模型
title.en: When the Knowledge Base Is Wrong, the Model Usually Isn't

subtitle.zh: AI-FDE 转型之路 · AI 工程 04-RAG 全链路
subtitle.en: The AI-FDE Transition Path · AI Engineering 04 — The Full RAG Pipeline

summary.zh: RAG 是让模型开卷考。大部分活其实在检索这一侧，所以答不准时先拆链路、打中间结果、按故障表定位，而不是先换模型。
summary.en: RAG is an open-book exam for the model. Most of the work happens on the retrieval side, so when answers are wrong, split the pipeline, print the intermediate results and use a triage table — don't start by swapping the model.
